moments.title: Autumn Equinox at Stonehenge
moments.blurb: Today marks the Autumn Equinox, and English Heritage is providing free managed open access to Stonehenge for the sunrise celebrations.

angles.name: Sunrise at Stonehenge
angles.copy: Happy Autumn Equinox! If you're up early, English Heritage is offering free access to Stonehenge for a truly special sunrise this morning. What a way to welcome the new season!

angles.name: Seasonal Shift
angles.copy: The official start of autumn is here! Today is the Autumn Equinox, bringing equal day and night. Time for cosy vibes and crisp air. What's your favourite thing about autumn?

moments.title: Wales face Portugal in Nations League
moments.blurb: Wales kicks off a busy UEFA Nations League campaign with an away fixture against Portugal on Thursday, September 24th.

angles.name: Game Day Wales
angles.copy: Cymru am byth! 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁷󠁬󠁳󠁿 Tomorrow, Wales takes on Portugal away in their first UEFA Nations League match. All the best to the Dragons!

angles.name: Nations League Kicks Off
angles.copy: The UEFA Nations League is back! Wales starts their journey tomorrow against a tough Portugal side. How do you think our boys will do?

moments.title: England vs Spain in Nations League
moments.blurb: England faces Spain in their opening UEFA Nations League group stage match at Wembley Stadium on Saturday, September 26th.

angles.name: Three Lions Return
angles.copy: Big game Saturday! England takes on Spain in the UEFA Nations League at Wembley. Can the Three Lions get off to a winning start? #ENGESP

angles.name: Wembley Showdown
angles.copy: England vs Spain: A Nations League clash at Wembley this Saturday! Who are you backing to shine for Gareth Southgate's side?

moments.title: Laver Cup 2026 at The O2
moments.blurb: The Laver Cup, a unique team tennis competition, takes place at The O2 in London from September 25th to 27th, featuring top players from Europe and the Rest of the World.

angles.name: Tennis in London
angles.copy: Tennis fever hits London this weekend! The Laver Cup is at The O2 from Friday, bringing together the best of Team Europe and Team World. Who are you supporting?

angles.name: Team Europe vs Team World
angles.copy: It's Team Europe vs Team World at the Laver Cup in London this weekend! Expect thrilling matches and big names. Get ready for some epic tennis!

moments.title: Sienna Spiro holds UK No. 1
moments.blurb: Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' remains the UK Official Singles Chart number one for the week ending September 24, 2026.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still at number one! Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' holds strong at the top of the UK Official Singles Chart. What a track!

angles.name: Spiro's Reign
angles.copy: Another week, another number one for Sienna Spiro! 'Great Expectation' is officially the UK's biggest song. Are you loving it?

moments.title: Spice Girls' 'Wannabe' back on vinyl chart
moments.blurb: Thirty years after its release, Spice Girls' iconic debut single 'Wannabe' has re-entered the UK Official Vinyl Singles Chart Top 10 at No. 7.

angles.name: Spice Up Your Life
angles.copy: Girl Power! The Spice Girls' 'Wannabe' is back in the UK Official Vinyl Singles Chart Top 10, three decades after it first dropped. Still an absolute banger!

angles.name: Vinyl Revival
angles.copy: Guess who's back in the vinyl charts? It's the Spice Girls with 'Wannabe'! Proof that true pop anthems never fade. What's your favourite Spice Girls track?

moments.title: Niall Horan at The O2 London
moments.blurb: Niall Horan brings his tour to The O2 in London for two nights on October 2nd and 3rd, part of his wider UK tour running until October 3rd.

angles.name: Niall Live in London
angles.copy: Get ready, London! Niall Horan is playing The O2 on October 2nd and 3rd. Who's got tickets to see him live?

angles.name: Catch Niall on Tour
angles.copy: Niall Horan's UK tour is in full swing, with dates at The O2 next week! Don't miss out if you want to catch him before the tour wraps up.

moments.title: Michael Ball's 'Glow' UK Tour
moments.blurb: Michael Ball continues his 'Glow' UK tour today with a performance in Bristol, running until October 5th across various venues.

angles.name: Ball in Bristol
angles.copy: The legendary Michael Ball is live in Bristol tonight as his 'Glow' UK tour continues! Who's heading out to see him perform?

angles.name: Glow Tour Continues
angles.copy: Michael Ball is lighting up stages across the UK with his 'Glow' tour! Catch him if you can, his voice is as brilliant as ever.

moments.title: 'Scrubs' returns for new series on Disney+
moments.blurb: The beloved medical comedy 'Scrubs' is reportedly returning for a brand new series, premiering on Disney+ in the UK on October 1st.

angles.name: Scrubs is Back!
angles.copy: Your favourite doctors are back! 'Scrubs' is returning with a brand new series on Disney+ from October 1st. Are you ready for more JD and Turk?

angles.name: New Season Alert
angles.copy: Huge news for 'Scrubs' fans! A new season drops on Disney+ next week. Time to re-watch the classics to prepare!

moments.title: Bruce Springsteen turns 77
moments.blurb: Today, September 23rd, the legendary American rock singer-songwriter Bruce Springsteen celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Boss
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to 'The Boss', Bruce Springsteen! A true rock icon whose music continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Springsteen track?

angles.name: Rock Legend Turns 77
angles.copy: Sending birthday wishes to the one and only Bruce Springsteen, who turns 77 today! Still bringing the house down after all these years. #TheBoss

moments.title: Julio Iglesias turns 83
moments.blurb: The iconic Spanish singer Julio Iglesias celebrates his 83rd birthday today, September 23rd.

angles.name: Feliz Cumpleaños Julio
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the legendary Julio Iglesias! His romantic voice has charmed millions around the world. What's your favourite song by him?

angles.name: Easy Listening Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Julio Iglesias! An incredible career and timeless music. #BirthdayWishes

moments.title: Natalie Horler (Cascada) turns 45
moments.blurb: Natalie Horler, lead singer of the hugely successful Eurodance act Cascada, celebrates her 45th birthday today, September 23rd.

angles.name: Everytime We Touch...
angles.copy: Happy 45th Birthday to Natalie Horler, the voice of Cascada! Get 'Everytime We Touch' stuck in your head all day in celebration! 🎉

angles.name: Dance Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 45th birthday to Natalie Horler from Cascada! Still making us want to hit the dance floor. What's your favourite Cascada hit?

moments.title: Will Smith turns 58
moments.blurb: Actor and rapper Will Smith celebrates his 58th birthday on Friday, September 25th.

angles.name: Fresh Prince's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 58th Birthday to the Fresh Prince himself, Will Smith, on Friday! From Bel-Air to blockbuster, he's a true icon. What's your favourite Will Smith song or movie?

angles.name: Big Willie Style
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 58th birthday to Will Smith this Friday! Still bringing the 'Big Willie Style' to everything he does. #HappyBirthdayWillSmith

moments.title: Gwen Stefani turns 57
moments.blurb: The lead singer of No Doubt and successful solo artist, Gwen Stefani, will celebrate her 57th birthday on Saturday, October 3rd.

angles.name: No Doubt, It's Her Birthday
angles.copy: Can you believe Gwen Stefani turns 57 this Saturday? The No Doubt icon and solo superstar still looks incredible! What's your favourite Gwen track?

angles.name: Pop Queen's Milestone
angles.copy: Happy early birthday to the one and only Gwen Stefani, celebrating 57 years this Saturday! From 'Don't Speak' to 'Hollaback Girl', she's done it all.

moments.title: Loch Lomond BAKEFEST26
moments.blurb: Scotland's Loch Lomond BAKEFEST26, a celebration of baking and sweet treats, takes place in Balloch on September 26th and 27th.

angles.name: Bake Off Scotland
angles.copy: Calling all bakers and sweet tooths in Scotland! Loch Lomond BAKEFEST26 is this weekend in Balloch. Who's going for some delicious treats?

angles.name: Weekend Treats
angles.copy: Fancy a weekend of cakes, pastries, and live demos? Loch Lomond BAKEFEST26 is happening Saturday and Sunday. Get your appetite ready!

moments.title: Disco for Grown Ups in Exeter
moments.blurb: The 'Disco for Grown Ups' event is happening at Exeter Corn Exchange on Friday, September 25th, promising a night of classic disco hits.

angles.name: Exeter Disco Night
angles.copy: Get your glitter on, Exeter! The 'Disco for Grown Ups' night is at the Corn Exchange this Friday. Time to relive those classic dancefloor anthems!

angles.name: Grown Up Grooves
angles.copy: Flashback to the disco era this Friday in Exeter! 'Disco for Grown Ups' is bringing all the best tunes to the Corn Exchange. Who's ready to boogie?

moments.title: Tulleys Farm Pumpkin Festival
moments.blurb: Tulleys Farm in West Sussex is currently hosting its annual Pumpkin Festival, running until October 31st with over a million pumpkins, food, and entertainment.

angles.name: Pumpkin Picking Fun
angles.copy: Autumn vibes are in full swing at Tulleys Farm's Pumpkin Festival in West Sussex! Perfect for family fun and getting those Instagram-worthy pumpkin shots. 🎃

angles.name: Seasonal Family Day Out
angles.copy: Looking for a seasonal day out? Tulleys Farm Pumpkin Festival is on now until Halloween, with a million pumpkins and lots of entertainment!
